blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT regress cameras and geometry in a single forward pass, but they report no uncertainty for the camera poses they predict: an incorrect relative pose looks no different from a correct one. We ask whether the frozen model nonetheless knows when its pose is wrong. On HardMatch, a benchmark of 1,000 deliberately difficult image pairs on which VGGT fails on 35% of pairs, a linear probe on VGGT's frozen features predicts pose failure on held-out categories with ROC-AUC 93.5%, compared with 79.7% for VGGT's own point-map confidence and 77.7% for a classifier trained on all of VGGT's outputs. The probe catches failures VGGT is confident about, lets a downstream system abstain on the pairs it distrusts, and transfers without retraining to rotation failures on PhotoTourism and ScanNet-1500, beyond what co-visibility explains. This knowledge is absent from the per-image encoder: it is computed partway through the layers that fuse the two views, and the same holds for a second model, $π^3$. In essence, we find that VGGT knows more about its own failures than it reports.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward 3D重建模型,如VGGT倒置相机和几何相机在一个单向前传中,但他们报告相机没有不确定性,他们提出预测:不正确的相对相机外观与正确的相机外观没有区别. 我们问被冻结的模型是否知道何时其姿势是错误的。 在HardMatch上,一个1000个故意困难的图像对的基准,VGGT在35%的对子上失败了,一个对VGGT被冻结特性的线性探测器预测,用ROC-AUC93.5%的被搁置类别会构成失败,而VGGT自己的点映射置信度为79.7%,一个接受过VGGT所有输出培训的分类器为77.7%. 探测器捕捉到故障 VGGT 有信心, 让下游系统放弃它不信任的对子, 每一图像编码器都缺少这种知识:它是通过连接两种观点的分层来计算出来的,第二种模型也一样,即3美元。 从本质上来说,我们发现VGGT比它报道的更了解自己的失败.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Feed-forward reconstruction models [ 25 , 14 , 23 , 24 , 26 , 15 , 12 ] predict cameras, depth and point maps from a set of images in a single forward pass, replacing much of the classical Structure-from-Motion (SfM) [ 7 ] pipeline.
VGGT [ 23 ] is the most widely used of these models.
It outputs a per-pixel confidence for depth and point maps, but no uncertainty for the camera poses it regresses. Downstream systems, such as SLAM, mapping, novel-view synthesis, therefore cannot distinguish a reliable relative pose from a badly wrong one.
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward重建模型 [25, 14, 23, 24, 26, 15, 12] 从一组图像中预测相机,深度和点地图在一个单一的前行通道中,取代了大部分古典结构-从运动(SfM)[7]管道.
VGGT [23] 是这些模型中应用最广泛的.
它输出出每像素对深度和点图的信心,但对相机没有不确定性,它会递减. 因此,下游系统,如SLAM,映射,小说-视觉合成,无法区分可靠的相对姿势和严重错误的姿势.

blocks.en:
Two observations make this gap worth studying.
First, these models do fail: on HardMatch [ 18 ] , a recent benchmark of hand-annotated, deliberately difficult image pairs, VGGT’s predicted geometry is grossly wrong (median epipolar error above 50 px) on 35% of pairs.
Second, the large-language-model literature has shown that internal representations often encode whether a model’s own output is correct [ 11 , 4 , 2 ] , even when the model’s stated confidence does not.
This motivates the question in our title: does a feed-forward 3D model know when its pose is wrong, and is that knowledge linearly readable from its frozen features?
blocks.zh:
两项观察使这一差距值得研究。
首先,这些模型确实失败了:在HardMatch [18] 上,最近一个手标注的,刻意困难的图像对等的基准,VGGT预测的几何在35%的对等上是严重错误(中间上位错超过50px).
第二,大语言-模型文献表明,内部表达往往会编码一个模型自己的输出是否正确[11,4,2],即使模型所声明的信心并不正确.
这激发了我们标题中的问题:一个向导的3D模型是否知道它的姿势是错的,而知识是否从被冻结的特征上线性地读取?

blocks.en: We answer it with linear probes [ 1 , 3 ] on frozen VGGT activations at every block, evaluated with category-grouped cross-validation so that every test category is unseen during training, and compared against everything VGGT itself outputs. The main contributions are as follows: • We show that VGGT’s frozen features encode its own pose failures far more clearly than anything it outputs (ROC-AUC 93.5 % 93.5\% vs . 79.7 % 79.7\% for its own confidence on HardMatch; Fig. 1 ), including failures it is confident about. • We locate where this knowledge forms: it is absent from the per-image encoder and emerges partway through the layers that fuse the views, in VGGT and in a second model, π 3 \pi^{3} . • We show that the signal is useful beyond the benchmark it was trained on: it supports selective prediction and transfers without retraining to rotation failures on PhotoTourism and ScanNet-1500.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: DUSt3R [ 25 ] regresses aligned point maps for an image pair and MASt3R [ 14 ] adds dense matching. VGGT [ 23 ] predicts cameras, depth, point maps and tracks for many views in one pass through alternating frame-wise and global attention; VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 24 ] , π 3 \pi^{3} [ 26 ] , Depth Anything 3 [ 15 ] and MapAnything [ 12 ] extend the recipe. These models expose per-pixel confidence for geometry, learned with an uncertainty-weighted loss, but no uncertainty for camera poses.
blocks.zh: DUST3R [25] 为一对图像反射对齐的点图,而MAST3R [14] 则会增加密度匹配. VGGT [23] 为许多视图预测相机,深度,点图和轨迹,一次通过交错的帧和全局关注; VGGT - 堆积 \Omega [24], 3\pi^{3} [26], 深度 Anything 3 [15] 和 Map Anything [12] 扩展配方. 这些模型暴露出每像素对几何学的信心,以不确定性加权损失来学习,但对相机没有不确定性.

blocks.en: Hillemann et al . [ 9 ] evaluate how well VGGT’s per-pixel confidence tracks depth and point errors on DTU and note that VGGT provides no pose uncertainty. ReVar3R [ 16 ] estimates per-point uncertainty by perturbing the inputs of a frozen model. Both target per-point geometry; we target the correctness of the predicted relative pose , and we read it from internal features rather than outputs or input perturbations.
blocks.zh: Hillemann et al. [9] 评估VGGT的每像素置信度跟踪深度和 DTU 上点出错的程度如何,并注意VGGT没有带来不确定性. ReVar3R [16]通过干扰被冻结的模型的输入,估计出每个点的不确定性. 两个目标每点几何;我们的目标是预测相对姿势的正确性,我们从内部特征而不是输出或输入扰动读取.

blocks.en: Zhang et al . [ 27 ] find an emergent ability to reason about non-overlapping views; Starý et al . [ 21 ] trace how relative pose forms across the layers of a DUSt3R variant; Nordström et al . [ 19 ] study what feed-forward 3D models know about image matching. Closest to us, Co-VGGT [ 28 ] probes VGGT’s layers for co-visibility . Co-visibility is a property of the scene; failure is a property of the prediction. HardMatch pairs are co-visible by construction, and on PhotoTourism our probe predicts failure beyond ground-truth co-visibility ( Sec. 4.3 ).

Failure prediction and selective prediction [ 8 , 6 , 13 ] typically train dedicated heads; we keep the model frozen and compare against the confidence it already emits.

blocks.en: 3.2 Probing for failure
blocks.zh: 3.2 检验失败

blocks.en: We hook seven depths of the frozen network: blocks 6 6 , 12 12 and 23 23 of the DINOv2-initialised [ 20 ] ViT encoder, which processes each image independently; the output of the aggregator’s last frame-attention block and last global (cross-frame) attention block; the normalised camera token that enters the camera head; and the input of the camera head’s trunk at its final refinement iteration. For the layer analysis we additionally pool the output of every one of the 24 24 encoder and 48 48 aggregator blocks. Tokens are mean-pooled per image, and a pair is represented by the mean of its two image vectors.

blocks.en: We compare against signals a user of VGGT already has, each with a direction fixed in advance: the lower of the two images’ mean point-map confidence, the lower mean depth confidence, image sharpness (variance of the Laplacian), the predicted relative rotation angle, and the ratio of predicted focal lengths. We also train classifiers, with the same cross-validation as the probes, on (i) all confidence statistics and (ii) everything VGGT outputs: confidence statistics, both extrinsics, focal lengths and relative rotation. Baseline (ii) asks whether the probe merely re-reads VGGT’s outputs.

blocks.zh: 所有探测器都遵循Sec. 3 :被冻结的VGGT,平均集合的令牌,128个PCA元件上的线性分解器,并按硬相克分类进行交叉验证,这样每个被报告的数字都会被测量到探测器从未见过的分解. 除非另有说明,否则探测器会读取最后一个全局关注区块(global_last),这是我们事先解决的选择. 代码将公开发布。

blocks.en: Table 2 compares what a user of VGGT can already observe with what is linearly readable inside it. The most informative output is the point-map confidence ( 79.7 % 79.7\% ), followed by depth confidence ( 66.5 % 66.5\% ); the predicted pose itself is nearly uninformative (relative rotation 62.9 % 62.9\% , focal ratio 51.1 % 51.1\% ). A classifier trained on everything VGGT outputs, including both cameras and every confidence statistic, reaches only 77.7 % 77.7\% , so the outputs contain little failure information beyond the point-map confidence. In contrast, a linear probe on any of the four late layers in Tab. 2 reaches 93 93 – 94 % 94\% , and adding the confidence statistics to the probe leaves it unchanged ( 93.5 % 93.5\% ). Thresholded at 0.5 0.5 , the probe labels 87.5 % 87.5\% of pairs correctly, catching 87.6 % 87.6\% of failures at 78.9 % 78.9\% precision; VGGT’s confidence, thresholded to flag about as many pairs, reaches 74.0 % 74.0\% accuracy, catching 68.3 % 68.3\% of failures at 61.4 % 61.4\% precision.
blocks.zh: 表2比较了VGGT的用户已经观察到的与其内部的可线性可读性. 最丰富的产出是点映射置信度(79.7% 79.7 % ) , 其次是深度置信度(66.5% 66.5 % ) ; 预测的姿势本身几乎是非信息化的(相对旋转62.9% 62.9 % , 焦距51.1% 51.1 % ) 。 接受过VGGT所有产出(包括相机和每个置信度统计)培训的分类器只达到77.7% 77.7 % , 因此输出中包含的故障信息很少超出点映射置信度。 相比之下,在Tab. 2的后四层中,任何一层的线性探测器都达到了93 — — 94 % — — 94 % — — 94 % — — 并在探测器上添加了置信度统计数据,使其保持不变(93.5% 93.5 % ) 。 探测器的阈值为0.5 % , 探测器标出87.5% 87.5 % — — 正确标记为87.6% 87.6 % — — 准确度为78.9% ; VGGT的置信度达到74.0% 74 % — — 准确度为68.3% — — 准确度为61.4 % 。

blocks.en: Table 2: VGGT’s features know more about its failures than anything it outputs. Predicting VGGT’s pose failures on HardMatch (failure: median epipolar error > 50 >50 px). ROC-AUC (%) with 95 % 95\% category-bootstrap CI, and average precision (AP, %). All learned rows use the same category-grouped cross-validation.
blocks.zh: 表2:VGGT的功能比它输出的任何东西更了解它的失败. 预测VGGT在硬盘上的失败(失败:中度起极误差 > 50 > 50 px ) 。 ROC-AUC (%) , 95% 95 % 类别-bootstrap CI, 平均精确度(AP,% ) 。 所有被学习到的行使用相同的类别分组交叉验证.

blocks.en: The gap has a plausible explanation. VGGT’s confidence is trained per pixel to down-weight hard-to-regress points; it describes how certain each depth or point is, not whether the two cameras are placed consistently. The fused features, by contrast, are the very representation from which the camera head regresses the relative pose, and they retain evidence that the two views were not registered consistently, which the camera head discards.
blocks.zh: 差距有一个合理的解释。 VGGT的自信被训练成每个像素到下重量的硬后退点;它描述了每个深度或点是如何确定的,而不是两个相机是否一致放置. 相形之下,引信特征是相机头反向相对姿势的表示,它们保留了两种观点没有一致记录的证据,相机头丢弃了这些证据。

blocks.en: Table 3 rules out the obvious artefacts. Shuffled labels give chance ( 51.6 % 51.6\% ), so the grouped cross-validation does not leak; image size and aspect ratio alone give chance ( 49.8 % 49.8\% ), so the padding of the input canvas does not leak the label. Pairs on which VGGT predicts an almost-zero baseline make the fundamental matrix ill-conditioned and could produce spurious failures, but the predicted baseline does not predict failure ( 49.9 % 49.9\% ) and removing those pairs leaves the probe at 93.4 % 93.4\% . The advantage over confidence holds at every threshold, on the official test split, and for every pair representation and PCA size we tried. Combining layers does not help, and combining the three backbone blocks still gives only 64.1 % 64.1\% .
blocks.zh: 表3排除了明显的艺术品。 被打乱的标签会给机会(51.6% 51.6\%),所以被分组的交叉验证不会漏出;仅图像大小和外观比就给机会(49.8% 49.8\%),所以输入画布的粘贴不会漏出标签. VGGT预测几乎为零的基线的对等使得基本矩阵条件恶劣并可能产生虚假的故障,但预测的基线没有预测故障(49.9% 49.9 % ),而去掉这些对子则使探测器以93.4%的93.4 % 离开. 信任的优势在于每个门槛,在正式测试分拆上,对于每一对代表以及我们所尝试的五氯苯甲醚大小。 组合层无济于事,组合出三个主干块仍然只给64.1%的64.1%.

ROC-AUC for predicting VGGT’s pose failures on HardMatch from every block of (a) VGGT and (b) π 3 \pi^{3} , with a linear probe (blue) and with one training-free number, the cosine similarity between the two views’ pooled features (orange). Dashed: the model’s own confidence. Shaded: the per-image encoder. The probe is flat through the encoder and the first half of the cross-view layers, then rises within a few blocks; only in VGGT does the training-free similarity follow.

blocks.en: To locate the signal we probe every block of the network ( Fig. 3 a). The per-image encoder never exceeds 65.2 % 65.2\% : what makes a pair hard is not visible in either image alone. More surprisingly, the first half of the aggregator adds nothing either, although it already alternates frame and global attention: through block 10 10 the probe stays between 63 % 63\% and 66 % 66\% . It then rises abruptly, from 69 % 69\% after block 11 11 to 81 % 81\% after block 12 12 , 88 % 88\% after block 13 13 and 93 % 93\% after block 15 15 , and stays at 93 93 – 94 % 94\% to the last block (peak 94.0 % 94.0\% , block 18 18 ). The failure signal is therefore not a by-product of the two views meeting; it is computed in a narrow band of middle aggregator blocks. A training-free reading appears later still. The cosine similarity between the two views’ pooled features stays at the encoder’s level ( 61 61 – 69 % 69\% ) through block 15 15 and then climbs to 83.7 % 83.7\% at the last block, above VGGT’s own confidence: in its final layers, VGGT’s representations of the two views stop agreeing when its pose is wrong. At the camera token this similarity falls back to 71.0 % 71.0\% while a trained probe stays at 93.2 % 93.2\% ; the information is still present, but no longer as a simple disagreement.
blocks.zh: 为了定位信号,我们探测网络的每个区块(图3a)。 每个图像编码器从未超过65.2%的65.2% : 使一对硬的 单在图像中都看不到 更令人惊讶的是, 集合器的前半部分也没有增加任何内容, 尽管它已经取代了框架和全球关注: 通过第10项, 然后突然上升,从第11区之后的69 % 69%上升到第12区之后的81 % 81 %;第13区之后的88 % 88 %;第15区之后的93 %;最后的93 % —94 %94 %(高峰94.0%;第18区18 % ) 。 因此,故障信号不是两个观点会议的副产品;它是用狭长的中间集合块来计算的。 后来出现了免费阅读。 两种观点的集合特征的同心相似性仍然停留在编码器的层面上(61 61 — 69 % 69 — — — — — — — — — — —通过第15个区块,然后在最后一个区块攀升到83.7%的83.7 — — — — — — — 高于VGGT自身的信心:在最后一层,VGGT对两种观点的表述在姿势出错时不再表示同意。 在相机上,这种相似性可回落到71.0% 71.0\%;而训练有素的探测器仍停留在93.2% 93.2\%;信息仍然存在,但不再是简单的分歧.

blocks.en: π 3 \pi^{3} [ 26 ] also alternates frame-wise and global attention, but has no reference view and predicts camera-to-world poses and local point maps, from which we recover the focal length by least squares. We run it on the same pairs with the same failure definition. It fails on 34.6 % 34.6\% of them (mAA@10 18.4 % 18.4\% on the test split) and agrees with VGGT’s failure label on 81 % 81\% . Table 4 repeats the main comparison. π 3 \pi^{3} ’s own confidence is a weaker failure signal than VGGT’s ( 62.2 % 62.2\% ), and on its most confident half, where 27 % 27\% of pairs still fail, it is at chance ( 52.8 % 52.8\% ). A probe on its last decoder block nonetheless reaches 91.7 % 91.7\% , against 76.9 % 76.9\% for a classifier trained on all of its outputs, and 92.7 % 92.7\% on that most confident half. The layer profile repeats as well ( Fig. 3 b): flat through the encoder and the first 21 21 decoder blocks ( ≤ 67 % \leq 67\% ), then a steep rise to 92 % 92\% by block 33 33 . One difference is instructive: in π 3 \pi^{3} the training-free cosine never rises ( ≤ 69 % \leq 69\% ). Failure is linearly decodable in both models, but the simple reading that the two views stop agreeing is specific to VGGT.
blocks.zh: 相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 我们用同样的失败定义运行它。 它在其中34.6%的34.6\%(mAA@10 18.4% 18.4\%在测试分出)上失败,并同意VGGT在81 % 81\%上的失败标签. 表4重复了主要比较. 3\pi^{3} 自己的信心是比VGGT的失败信号更弱(62.2 % 62.2 % ) , 而最自信的二分之一(27 % ) 仍然失败,这是偶然的(52.8 % ) 。 尽管如此,对最后一个解码器块的探测器还是达到了91.7%的91.7 % , 而接受过所有产出培训的分类器则达到了76.9%的76.9 % , 而最自信的二分之一则达到了92.7 % 。 地层剖面也重复(图3b):平地通过编码器和前21个21个解码器区块( 67%\leq 67\%),再由33个区块陡增至92%92\%. 不同之处之一在于:在\ 3\ pi\ 3} 无训练余弦从未上升(\ 69%\ leq 69\ ) 。 失败在两种模型中都是可线性解码的,但是两种观点停止同意的简单读取是VGGT特有的.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Within each level of confidence, VGGT’s confidence is near chance; the probe is not. HardMatch pairs split into quartiles of VGGT’s point-map confidence. Bars: VGGT’s failure rate. Lines: ROC-AUC for predicting failure within each quartile.
blocks.zh: 图4:VGGT的信心在每一层次的置信度内,都近乎偶然;探测器没有. HardMatch配对被分解为VGGT的点-映射置信度的四分法. 栏: VGGT故障率. 线路:ROC-AUC用于预测每克范围内的故障.

blocks.en: Confidence and failure are correlated at the level of the whole benchmark, but how much does confidence tell us once we already know it? We split the pairs into quartiles of point-map confidence. The failure rate falls from 64 % 64\% in the least confident quartile to 6 % 6\% in the most confident, yet within each quartile confidence ranks failures close to chance ( Fig. 4 ) (AUC 47 % 47\% , 61 % 61\% , 64 % 64\% , 57 % 57\% ) while the probe stays high ( 90 % 90\% , 91 % 91\% , 92 % 92\% , 82 % 82\% ). On the most confident half of the pairs, where 12.2 % 12.2\% still fail, the probe reaches 90.0 % 90.0\% [ 85.4 85.4 , 94.2 94.2 ] against 69.9 % 69.9\% [ 61.2 61.2 , 77.8 77.8 ]. These are the failures a downstream system cannot see. Figure 2 shows examples: an aerial-to-ground pair, a large viewpoint change and a photograph matched to a drawing, all of which VGGT places confidently but wrongly and the probe flags, together with a correct pair on which confidence raises a false alarm and an extreme-zoom pair the probe misses.
blocks.zh: 信心和失败在整个基准层面是相互关联的,但一旦我们已经知道,信心会告诉我们多少? 我们把对子分割成四分法的点-相扑信心. 失败率从最不自信的64%的64分下降到最自信的6%的6分之6分;然而,在每对信心中,失败率都接近概率(图4)(AUC 47 % 47分、61 % 61 % 61分、64 % 64分、57 % 57分之57分),而探测器仍然很高(90 % 90分、91 % 91分之91分、92 % 92分之92分、82 % 82分之82分)。 在最有信心的二分之一,12.2% 12.2%的12分之12分仍然失败,探测器达到了90.0% 90分之90分[85.4 85.4分、94.2分],而69.9%的69.9分[61.2分、77.8分77.8分之8]。 这些是下游系统无法看到的失败。 图2显示了一些例子:一对空对地、一对大视线变化和一张照片与一幅画相匹配,所有照片都是VGGT自信地但错误地放出并标出探测旗,以及一对正确的对子,在对子上,信心引起假警报并被探测器错失了一对极子.

blocks.en: Failure rates vary widely across HardMatch’s categories, from 27 % 27\% on building and texture pairs to 74 % 74\% on celestial ones ( Fig. 5 ). The probe exceeds VGGT’s confidence in every category with enough pairs except doppelgängers, where both reach 92 % 92\% ; the largest gains are on the categories where appearance changes most, namely celestial ( 82 % 82\% vs . 60 % 60\% ), drawing ( 95 % 95\% vs . 77 % 77\% ) and illumination ( 92 % 92\% vs . 71 % 71\% ).
blocks.zh: 从建筑和纹理对等的27 %到天体对等的74 %(图5), 探测器超过了VGGT对每一类足够一对的信心,但二重身除外,两者都达到了92 % 92 % ;最大的收益出现在外观变化最大的类别上,即:天体(82 % 82 % 对 60 % ) 、 绘图(95 % 95 % 对 77 % 77 % ) 和照明(92 % 92 % 对 71 % ) 。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : The probe beats VGGT’s confidence in every HardMatch category but one. Bars: VGGT’s failure rate. Markers: AUC of the probe (filled) and of point-map confidence (open).
blocks.zh: 图5:探测器超越了VGGT对每个"硬棋"类别的信心,但只有一门. 酒吧:VGGT的故障率. 标记:探测器(已填充)和点映射置信度(开口)的AUC.

blocks.en: A system that can abstain on some pairs, for example by requesting another view or falling back to a slower pipeline, needs a ranking rather than a calibrated probability. Keeping the 50 % 50\% of pairs the probe trusts most yields a 3.8 % 3.8\% failure rate and mAA@10 of 34.9 % 34.9\% ; ranking by VGGT’s confidence yields 12.4 % 12.4\% and 29.7 % 29.7\% , and a perfect oracle 0 % 0\% and 38.3 % 38.3\% ( Fig. 6 ). Over all coverages, the area under the risk–coverage curve is 0.096 0.096 for the probe, 0.154 0.154 for confidence, 0.169 0.169 for all outputs and 0.070 0.070 for the oracle, so the probe closes about 70 % 70\% of the gap between VGGT’s confidence and a perfect ranking.
blocks.zh: 一个系统可以对某些对子投弃权票,例如通过请求另一个视图或者倒回更慢的管道,需要排名而不是校正概率. 将50%的50%的对子保留下来,探测器所信任的大多数的失败率为3.8%.3.8%.%.,mAA@10为34.9%.34.9%.%.;根据VGGT的自信排名,结果为12.4%.12.4%.和29.7%.29.7%.,完美的甲骨文为0.0%.0.%.和38.3%.38.3%.(图6)。 在所有覆盖范围中,被风险覆盖曲线覆盖的区域为探测器0.096 0.096,置信器0.154,所有输出0.169 0.169,神谕0.070 0.070,因此探测器填补了VGGT信心与完美排名相差约70 % 。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Abstaining on the pairs the probe distrusts removes most of VGGT’s failures. Keeping the pairs ranked most reliable by each score: failure rate (left) and mAA@10 px (right) of the kept pairs. Oracle: ranked by true error.
blocks.zh: 图6:对对对的弃权 探测器不信任消除了VGGT的大部分失败. 保持对子按分数排名最可靠:被保留对子的失败率(左)和mAA@10px(右). 甲骨文:以真实错误排列.

blocks.en: We also tried to route each pair either to VGGT or to the dedicated matcher LoMa [ 18 ] . On HardMatch, LoMa (mAA@10 50.8 % 50.8\% on the test split) almost never does worse than VGGT ( 19.9 % 19.9\% ): even an oracle that always picks the better of the two reaches only 52.1 % 52.1\% , and a learned router that uses the probe reaches 51.1 % 51.1\% . With so little complementarity there is nothing for the probe to exploit, and we make no routing claim.
blocks.zh: 我们还试图将每对选手都引导到VGGT或专注的选手Loma[18]. 在HardMatch上,Loma(mAA@10 50.8% 50.8\%在测试分出时)几乎从来没有比VGGT更糟糕(19.9% 19.9\%):即使一个总是选择两个中优的神谕也只达到52.1% 52.1\%,一个使用探测器的已学路由器达到51.1% 51.1\%. 如此少的补充性 探测器没有什么可利用的 我们没有提出路线要求

blocks.en: 4.3 PhotoTourism: transfer to rotation failures
blocks.zh: 4.3 相机旅游:转至旋转失败

blocks.en: HardMatch defines failure through epipolar error, which mixes rotation, translation and intrinsics errors, and its probe is trained on HardMatch’s own categories. PhotoTourism [ 10 ] lets us test both limitations at once: its poses come from large-scale structure-from-motion, so failure can be defined on the rotation alone, and none of its images were used to train the probe. We sample 1,262 1{,}262 pairs from 16 16 landmarks, stratified into four bins of ground-truth co-visibility, and apply the HardMatch probe unchanged.

blocks.en: HardMatch defines its ground truth per pair, so our main study uses pairs. To test whether this matters, we sample 96 96 sets of 16 16 images from the PhotoTourism scenes and run VGGT on each set as one 16 16 -view pass, as two 8 8 -view passes, as four 4 4 -view passes, and on every pair inside the 4 4 -view groups, so that the same 2,304 2{,}304 pairs are predicted with 2 2 , 4 4 , 8 8 and 16 16 views ( Tab. 6 ). blocks.en: 4.4 ScanNet-1500: failure modes differ
blocks.zh: 4.4 ScanNet-1500:故障模式不同

blocks.en: ScanNet-1500 [ 5 , 22 ] is the standard indoor benchmark for relative pose: 1,500 1{,}500 pairs from 100 100 rooms, with poses from RGB-D reconstruction. Indoor scenes add low texture, repeated structure and, unlike PhotoTourism, many pairs taken from nearby positions.
blocks.zh: ScanNet 1500 [5, 22] 是相对姿势的标准室内基准:1500 1{,}从100个房间取出500对,并有由RGB-D重建而来出场的姿势. 室内场景会增加低纹理,再三结构,与相克旅游不同,许多对取自附近位置.

blocks.en: VGGT’s rotations on ScanNet are accurate (median error 1.2 ∘ 1.2^{\circ} ; only 2.1 % 2.1\% of pairs exceed 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} ). Its pose errors come almost entirely from the direction of the translation: 113 113 of the 115 115 pairs with pose error above 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} have a rotation error below 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} . These failures are concentrated on short baselines ( Tab. 7 , top): the translation direction is wrong by more than 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} on 47 % 47\% of pairs whose cameras are less than 10 10 cm apart, but on fewer than 1 % 1\% of pairs more than 40 40 cm apart. This is a known property of two-view geometry rather than a peculiarity of VGGT: when the cameras barely move, the direction of their small displacement is weakly constrained by the images.

blocks.en: The few rotation failures behave differently: they occur at the longest baselines ( 3.3 % 3.3\% of pairs above 40 40 cm, none below 20 20 cm), the regime closest to HardMatch’s wide-baseline pairs. For these, the HardMatch probe transfers: 79.5 % 79.5\% against 58.7 % 58.7\% for confidence, close to a probe trained on ScanNet itself ( 82.3 % 82.3\% ). For the translation-dominated failures it does not ( 44 44 – 48 % 48\% ), and VGGT’s confidence is only marginally better ( 61 61 – 64 % 64\% ). Yet a probe trained on ScanNet detects these failures with AUC 90.5 90.5 – 91.0 % 91.0\% . VGGT’s fused features therefore encode the short-baseline failures as well, but along a direction that a probe trained on HardMatch’s gross failures does not learn. Failure awareness is not a single scalar inside the model: one linear readout carries across datasets for wrong orientation, and ill-conditioned translation calls for its own.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: Two models. We study VGGT and π 3 \pi^{3} ; larger or newer models (VGGT- Ω \Omega , MapAnything) may behave differently, and the training-free cosine reading already differs between the two. Labels. HardMatch has no ground-truth poses, so failure is defined through the epipolar error of about 11 11 annotated correspondences per pair, which mixes rotation, translation and intrinsics errors; the ground-truth datasets confirm the result for rotation but have few failures (PhotoTourism: 22 22 above 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} ). Two views. We study image pairs, because HardMatch defines its ground truth per pair. With more views, failures on PhotoTourism become rare ( 0.3 % 0.3\% with 16 16 views) and the two-view probe is no longer clearly better than VGGT’s confidence on them; filtering edges by the probe also did not improve rotation averaging ( Sec. 4.3 ). Supervision. The probe is trained with failure labels, whereas VGGT’s confidence is free. We therefore compare against classifiers trained on VGGT’s outputs under the same protocol, and test the probe on data it was not trained on. Failure modes. A single probe does not cover short-baseline translation errors ( Sec. 4.4 ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
VGGT knows more about its own failures than it reports.
A linear readout of its frozen features predicts when its relative pose is wrong far better than its own confidence or anything else it outputs, including when it is confident; it supports selective prediction and transfers to rotation failures on other datasets.
The signal emerges abruptly in the middle of the network, in both VGGT and π 3 \pi^{3} .
Costing one linear layer on features the model already computes, it is a practical reliability signal for systems built on feed-forward reconstruction, and evidence that self-knowledge, studied extensively in language models, is also present in 3D foundation models.
blocks.zh:
VGGT比它报道的更了解自己的失败.
其被冻结特性的线性读取预言,当其相对姿势远好于自身信心或任何其它东西时,包括自信时;它支持选择性预测并转移到其他数据集的旋转故障.
信号突然出现在网络中间,
在已经计算模型的特征上计算一个线性层的成本,对于基于向上重建的系统来说,它是实用的可靠性信号,并且有证据表明,在语言模型中广泛研究的自我知识也存在于3D基础模型中.
